title: Polynomial-time equality of computed words
statement: Let $f,g : \{0,1\}^* \to \{0,1\}^*$ be polynomial-time computable. The function that maps each binary word $x$ to the one-bit word recording whether $f(x)=g(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
replaced: Let $f$ and $g$ be polynomial-time computable functions on binary strings. Then the single-bit function recording whether $f(x) = g(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
